load_jsonl_file: load a JSONL file and return a list of dictionaries from each line
load_json_file: load a JSON file and return a dictionary with the parsed data
save_jsonl_file: save a list of dictionaries to a JSONL file with one JSON object per line
get_jsonl_files_in_dir: get a list of all JSONL file paths in a given directory
hash_uuid_to_int: hash a UUID string using SHA-256 and return the result as an integer
